purpose: City-specific cadastral-source research; findings are limited to observed first-party evidence.
name: Gulu

queries.query: Gulu Uganda cadastral parcel map land registry GIS official
queries.result: First-party discovery identified the Ministry of Lands, Housing and Urban Development (MLHUD) Uganda National Land Information System (UgNLIS), which manages spatially referenced land registration and cadastral processes and lists Gulu among its Ministry Zonal Offices. MLHUD also documents cadastral-map, parcel-location, and survey-data services. No open Gulu parcel download was found in discovery.

queries.language: Acholi (local; Luo-language official procedure wording also found)
queries.query: Gulu Acholi Uganda map of land parcels land registry official
queries.result: No distinct Acholi-language Gulu parcel viewer was found. First-party MLHUD discovery did identify Luo/Acholi land-registration procedure material and the UgNLIS national parcel/cadastral portal; this supports the same national custodian but does not provide a local open parcel geometry endpoint.

registryEvidence.custodian: Uganda Ministry of Lands, Housing and Urban Development; Uganda National Land Information System; Gulu Ministry Zonal Office
registryEvidence.scopeNote: The official UgNLIS page explicitly lists Gulu as a Ministry Zonal Office and describes a national spatial land-registration system. This evidences a local registry custodian/service presence, not complete municipal parcel coverage or open citywide geometry.

officialSources.observation: MLHUD describes UgNLIS as managing spatially referenced land registration, valuation, planning and administration data across Uganda and lists Gulu among the Ministry Zonal Offices.
The current public portal loaded successfully and its JavaScript configuration exposed parcel-search and cadastral-division-map routes.
The official department page identifies cadastral survey/map responsibilities and public survey-data, deed-plan, site-plan and map services.
MLHUD publishes land-registration procedures including Luo/Acholi-language material for customary ownership.

parcelDiscovery.note: The portal bundle was inspected for current configuration. It exposes query-parcelle boundaries, commune, localities, parcel-search, getParcel, and cadastral-division-map routes, but no anonymous bounded parcel response was obtained. The exact WUP point was preserved and not shifted or used as an absence test.

uncertainty: UgNLIS is a national land information system with a Gulu zonal-office presence, but citywide Gulu parcel coverage and municipal-boundary correspondence were not verified.
The current API host returned the portal shell for the inspected anonymous routes; this is an unusable direct response, not evidence of citywide parcel absence.
